newsitem.title: USA: Texas power prices show more strength with natgas.
newsitem.headline: Texas power prices show more strength with natgas.

text.p: Bulk wholesale power prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT) showed more strength Tuesday, again strengthened by rising natural gas prices in the state, industry sources said.
"All the talk is about gas," said a Houston-based ERCOT marketer.
Spot gas prices in Texas were said to have climbed again Tuesday, following sharp gains made Monday.

Peak, firm electricity in ERCOT for Wednesday delivery was said to have traded mostly near $29.00 for a 16-hour block from trade near $28.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) on Monday, brokers and marketers said.
Peak electricity was said to have traded at $30 per MWh for a six-hour Wednesday block, although the trade was not confirmed.
Off-peak ERCOT power for Tuesday delivery also moved higher to near $21.00 per MWh from discussion around $17.00 on Monday, the sources said.
November peak ERCOT power was discussed steady at $22.50-23.30, while December peak power was talked at $22.75-23.00, the sources said.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
